programme.title: The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.desc: Gusto TV’s Wizard of Whatever, Chef Kyle Crawford, is dishing up a holiday feast! There’ll be food, fun, elves… and even jolly old St. Nick himself may make an appearance! Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions.

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: Spencer's Big Holiday
programme.desc: No matter how you celebrate the holidays, let Spencer Watts help you plan the menu, in SPENCER’S BIG HOLIDAY! In this festive one-hour holiday special, Spencer Watts is serving up some of his favourite holiday meals, treats, and drinks. Follow Spencer as he shows us how to sail through the hectic holiday season with style, from brunch to the moment the clock strikes midnight.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is near, and the pressure is on! Between work, home, friends, and family, the list of people to buy for is endless. To help us through this busy time, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: EDIBLE GIFTS offers up four creative and more personal options to make the holidays cheaper, sweeter, and filled with love. Fun host Jessica McGovern shows us how to bake something for everyone including Crispy Brittle Bark covered in chocolate, rich Coal Cookies that are sweet with a bit of heat, adorable peanut butter-chocolate Reindeer Cupcakes, and easy-to-make Christmas Puzzle Cookies.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: The video captures a diverse range of musical performances, each with its own unique style and energy. Jesse Teasdale and Jade share their experiences running Golden Fries at Bluesfest Ottawa, highlighting the busy and memorable nights they have encountered. They discuss their popular menu items, including the classic poutine and crispy chicken poutine, and how they cater to large orders from artists and their crews. The video also features snippets of heartfelt and passionate lyrics from various songs, showcasing themes of love, longing, and personal reflection. Viewers will experience the dynamic atmosphere of Bluesfest Ottawa, the dedication of the Golden Fries team, and the emotional depth conveyed through the musical performances. This content offers a blend of culinary entrepreneurship, festival culture, and musical artistry.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it.

programme.title: VegHeadz
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more.

programme.title: LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more.

programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 6

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Cruising the City of Joy
programme.desc: Our host dives deep into the rich stew of colonial legacies and neighborhood traditions.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Delhi to Manali

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Tying the Knot at 13,000ft
programme.desc: A Romantic trip to Colorado takes a windy turn when Jason pushes Tayler, despite her hesitation, to summit Mt. Democrat in 70 mph winds and -19 degree weather.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "A Newly-Wed Recipe for Disaster
programme.desc: Jason loves mountain biking. Tayler prefers to read a book. Jason is up for any adventure tossed at him. Tayler likes to be a bit more prepared. Will the adventures that await in Arkansas leave the couple questioning if they have anything in common.

programme.title: Love On The Rocks S1 - "Theodora's Room
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason travel to Eureka Springs, AR, a town with a rich history and home to one of the most haunted hotels in America, The Crescent. Jason convinces Tayler to stay one night, but will that stay lead to a night they don't want to remember.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Feline Cool
programme.desc: Chris takes the plunge into mysterious waters, comes to the aid of a tropical turtle, reveals a hot new LA playground, and makes new feline friends in a cool city café.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "A Pirate's Life
programme.desc: Chris travels to China for a unique adventure, gets in touch with his inner pirate, checks out a pet friendly city in Australia, and visits a remote Pacific island where a bird species is under threat.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S3 - "Bondi Backyard
programme.desc: Chris visits China and explores a masterpiece of history , is shadowed by giants on Australia’s Great Barrier Reef, takes on a photo challenge in his own Bondi backyard, and joins a safari to a coastal community, well off the grid.

programme.title: Epic Exploring S1 - "U.S.A. / Belgium
programme.desc: While Cody explores lost industries in the ‘ugliest’ city in the world with freerunner Abudi Alsagoff, Josh, together with his old neighborhood friend John Yurei, is in the famous American prison 'Joliet', where prisoners build their own cells.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Desert Holiday
programme.desc: A London family relocates to run a gite in rural France. Two friends compete to open a Spanish seafront bar and Expats test a holiday complex in the Spanish desert.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "France
programme.desc: A pool leak threatens plans at a Spanish holiday complex. A French family questions their renovation challenge and new Spanish bar owners prepare for tourist season.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. Hainan’s four famous dishes are chicken, duck, goat and crab.

programme.title: Foodwise S3 - "Xishuangbanna Part 1
programme.desc: From dazzling night markets to lush bamboo forests, 800 year old tea trees to close encounters with elephants, this tropical city in southwest China has everything, and is where the story of tea begins.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat Australia S2 - "Everyone needs a little bit of Yorke
programme.sub-title: Everyone needs a little bit of Yorke
programme.desc: Andy explores the Yorke Peninsula,harvests oysters,cooks blue swimmer crab pasta,then forages with Quenten Agius before cooking fresh local butterfish.

programme.title: Andy & Ben Eat Australia S2 - "Melbourne: the CBD Experience
programme.desc: Andy reunites with Ben in Melbourne for dining at CODA, a city food crawl and a night exploring Melbourne's vibrant cocktail bar scene.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S4 - "Uluwatu, York
programme.desc: Lynton is exploring the marvellous architecture and trendy eateries of Shanghai. Scotty wraps up his Canadian adventure. Lynton is in Uluwatu, enjoying a beautiful part of Indonesia. Carolyne visits the historical town of York.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweetness Migration
programme.desc: The program reveals the unique attraction of sweet food that allows it to transcend geographical boundaries to become a bond shared worldwide, a form of cultural expression, and a means of heritage prevention.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Miami
programme.desc: James Lance gets to grips with his Colombian roots while trying to build a career as a Latin hip hop artist. After raising himself as a teenager, he refuses to give up and dreams of a better future.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Extreme Homes
programme.desc: Australia is an enormous continent and it has profound variations in climate. Johanna and Pete find Australian designers who have responded to the radical climate by producing some very extreme architecture.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Vintage Twist
programme.desc: Johanna and Pete explore a collection of Australian vintage homes that have been masterfully renovated to meet the needs of modern living without destroying the past.

programme.title: Australia's Amazing Homes S1 - "Inventive Architecture
programme.desc: Explore a collection of houses that have one thing in common - the designers have come up with inventive ideas and radical approaches to solving everyday design issues. It's both clever and inspiring with plenty of take home tips for the home renovator.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Coolest Places: Off the Beaten Path
programme.sub-title: Coolest Places: Off the Beaten Path
programme.desc: Discover unknown spots by cave diving in Madagascar, hot air ballooning in Myanmar, and goat racing in Trinidad and Tobago.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Coolest Road Trips on Earth
programme.desc: Drive New Zealand’s North Island, explore historic England, tour the American West, and honor a Great Lakes sailboat race.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Coolest Malta Adventure
programme.desc: Sail to Malta for a historic car grand prix, deep-sea fishing, shipwreck diving, medieval tours, and local food festivals.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Infinite View (Part 1)
programme.desc: Vicky is searching for a home in The Beaches for her and her family. No one knows the Beach like Inez Kudryk, so Vicky enlists her help in finding some stunning luxury properties to tour.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Infinite View (Part 2)
programme.desc: With a sizeable budget and very particular tastes, Inez knows that Vicky will be a tough client to please. Will Vicky find the forever home of her dreams.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Sunset on the Patio (Part 1)
programme.desc: Steve Bailey to save the day! This week's episode features the lovely couple Chris and Rosa as they search for the perfect home. While Rosa is mainly concerned with cutting down her commute, Chris just wants to feel a connection to a property.

programme.title: Travel in Style S3 - "Lake Como & Stockholm
programme.desc: In the footsteps of Hollywood royalty we’re heading to Italy’s Lake Como. Then it’s time to relax with a Swedish massage in the Scandinavian city of Stockholm.

programme.title: Travel in Style S3 - "Ice Hotel & Cayman
programme.desc: Braving artic conditions and spending a night in the beautiful but chilly Ice Hotel. Then its thawing out time in the Cayman Islands, swimming in the clear warm Caribbean waters and having fun playing with dolphins.

programme.title: Travel in Style S3 - "St Tropez & Ulagalla
programme.desc: Join us in St Tropez, the playground of the French Riviera where the rich and famous flock each year to sunbath in style. It’s then culture vulture time when we visit some magnificent temples in Sri Lanka.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "The Ice Hotel V Barbados
programme.desc: In freezing temperatures Gill attempts a Jet Set Victory by sculpting her very own ice cat. Unfortunately it leaves Dave feeling rather scared. Richard attempts to heat up the competition from the Caribbean island of Barbados.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "Chiang Mai V Venice
programme.desc: Richard immerses himself in Thai culture, picking his own rice, learning to cook Thai style with a local top chef and paying a visit to a retired elephant park. While Gill heads to the Italian city of Venice, for a cheeky Bellini in Harry’s Bar.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "Eze (France) V Stockholm
programme.desc: From the French Riviera, Richard attempts to win the episode from his hotel, where every house in the town is actually a hotel suite. Meanwhile Gill tours the Swedish capital of Stockholm, sailing around the archipelago.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "French Renovation
programme.desc: How will Spain’s latest hoteliers deal with the feedback from their guests? After tiresome work, a French renovation project hits crisis point and a family moves to the Costa del Sol to open their dream bar.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Review Rankings
programme.desc: A family faces eviction hours after arriving in Spain. In France, a couple seeks creative funding for their dream and the owners of a Spanish bar embark on a mission to climb the review rankings.

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Hypnotherapy
programme.desc: In Spain, two best friends reveal their big business plans at the end of a successful summer. A bar inches dangerously close to failure, and a rookie hypnotherapist finds his true calling in France.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "Mildura, Vienna, Hahndorf
programme.desc: Join Alana as she visits her home town of Mildura and then onto the beautiful Austrian capital Vienna. Scotty heads up north to the Western Australian pearl town of Broome and Skye explores the delicacies of Hahndorf, South Australia.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "Vienna, Broome, Barossa Valley
programme.desc: Alana visits the fresh food market in Vienna and Scotty tucks into one of Broome’s signature dishes. Skye’s in the historic town of Hahndorf and learns about its German heritage before visiting Australia’s premium wine region of the Barossa Valley.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "New South Wales, Budapest
programme.desc: Scotty visits the New South Wales south coast while Alana continues her European tour in Budapest while Skye tries her hand at golf in the world-renowned wine region of the Barossa Valley.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Kazaringa: Land of Giants
programme.desc: The three biggest—elephant, buffalo and rhino are found in large numbers in only one national park in India—Kazaringa. Join Bill as he attempts to check each of these highly endangered and dangerous herbivores off his bucket list.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Jaisalmer: India’s Hidden Gem
programme.desc: Every major country has a destination that is incredible but not well known to outsiders—Jaisalmer is such a place. Once a major stop along the silk road, this living museum and surrounding countryside has something for everyone.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Gujarat: Land of Extremes
programme.desc: The people and wildlife of the western state of Gujarat have found ways to survive in an inhospitable environment. Unique big game exists side-by-side with some of the most talented and unique craftsman in the world.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Dream Homes
programme.desc: Lovebirds Jess & Simon need help from their parents to buy a home on Auckland’s North Shore and Queenstown couple Will & Grace prepare to go to auction on their dream home.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Newlyweds
programme.desc: Newly wed immigrants Sam & Maria get some inside info from a real estate agent as they search for a home for their future family.. and in Auckland, North Shore duo Jess & Simon prepare to go to auction on their dream home, but will their budget of $615,000 be enough.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Family Affair
programme.desc: Siblings Courtney and Tom join forces with their partners and younger sister Natalie to buy their first home in Auckland, but can they find a place big enough to make their dreams of communal living a reality? And in Wellington will visa delays put an end to Sam & Maria’s dreams of home ownership.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Sunset on the Patio (Part 2)
programme.desc: Unfortunately for Rosa, she isn't seeing the benefits of moving to a town around Cambridge. Steve's got some neat ideas, but will they be able to convince Rosa.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Sweet Home Belize (Part 1)
programme.desc: Sofie Kehdi heads to the island of Ambergris Caye, Belize to help a friend, actress and choreographer Zuzana Marosová. As a public figure, Zuzana craves privacy in her personal time and is looking for a relaxing space to unwind with her children.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "Sweet Home Belize (Part 2)
programme.desc: With the help of local realtor Daniel Hartin, Sofie sets her sights on the perfect home...and hopefully a bit of fun in the sun.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Coolest Scotland Vacation
programme.desc: Experience beautiful Scotland through mountain biking, whitewater rapids, famous castle tours, vibrant cities, and a round of golf.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S2 - "Exotic Central and South America
programme.desc: Uncover ancient ruins in Belize, walk blue glaciers in Argentina, relax in sunny Aruba, and discover the hot spots of Chile.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Ireland
programme.desc: It’s the birthplace of Halloween, but the ghosts and ghouls which have canvassed the world have not scared up much interest in Irish cuisine. Mounting a classic motorcycle Jonathan tours a land of mystic traditions, boisterous locals, and iconic scenery. The world’s most magnetic pub culture draws him in, border conflict pushes him out, and dark legends pull him around. It’s an adventure soaked in rain, lore, and the food of ancestor’s past.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Russia
programme.desc: Jonathan faces his toughest challenge yet as he enters a country that has been coming to grips in defining and understanding their own cuisine. Through the historical turmoil and harsh climate, Russia has lost it’s traditional way of cooking, and eating. But the country is reviving this culture; Jonathan ventures the far stretches of the country to learn about modern cooks, as well as ancient kitchens housing the one key tool that gave birth to true Russian cuisine, the Russian oven. He’ll learn their insights, understand their efforts, and work with traditional Russian ingredients to learn what the cuisine used to be, and where it’s headed today.

programme.title: Miguel's Feasts S1 - "Goats Cheese and Rice Paper Rolls
programme.sub-title: Goats Cheese and Rice Paper Rolls
programme.desc: Miguel searches for creamy goat cheese, learns authentic rice paper roll techniques, and creates a strawberry rocky road dessert.

programme.title: Miguel's Feasts S1 - "Romantic Dinner and Hotel Cooking
programme.desc: Miguel demystifies olive oil, guides a novice through a romantic dinner, and sets out to cook a gourmet meal inside a hotel room.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "Collision Chaos
programme.desc: The ride takes a dramatic turn when Bhaskar totals the support car. With Ridermania just days away, Jess and the team scramble to salvage their journey, redistributing luggage onto their bikes. They push on through Karnataka, reaching Gokarna’s beaches, only for another setback to hit when a rider is caught in a collision.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "Ridermania
programme.desc: After a crash leaves Zombie injured, the crew scrambles to stay on schedule for Ridermania. Jess arrives at the festival, participates in events and is met with overwhelming support from fans and fellow riders. The three-day celebration ends with a visit to a famous Goa beach before the crew heads to Ganpatipule.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S1 - "Ladakh, the Mountain Adventure
programme.desc: Jonathan embarks on a two wheeled journey over the highest roads in the world, stopping in remote monasteries to learn the secrets of Buddhism’s warrior demons and track down a secreted manuscript rumored to explain the lost years of Jesus.

programme.title: Foodie Adventures with Ash Pollard S1 - "Italy
programme.desc: In Venice and San Daniele, Ash uncovers authentic prosciutto before returning home to cook an Italian feast for Joel Creasey.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Porsche Cayman GT4

programme.title: Tuning

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Scirocco GT-R1 from Mathilda Racing, the Bentley GT3 R and the Volkswagen Golf R. The Scirocco is a complete conversion. The Bentley GT3 R is the street version of the current GT3 racer. And the Golf R is the most powerful Golf ever.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: In Dubai, the legendary super sports car police fleet is on the hunt for speeders and parking violators. Also: the Audi S8 MTM Talladega R. And: the Alpina D5 on the race track.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The BMW 3 Series, Nissan 370 Z or Citroen DS3 are usually considered everyday cars. But in the M version, as a Nismo or as a Musketier, things get down to business in terms of performance.

programme.title: Toyota Corolla Levin

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Do you want to feel like a race driver without being limited to a race track? If so, the British manufacturer Radical has the perfect solution for you. programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Cadillac Escalade

programme.desc: The sound of the McLaren 720S Spider is that of an uncompromising driving machine. Also: the F-Pace SVR makes a rather sophisticated impression. And: is the Porsche Cayenne coupe's higher price justifiable compared to the regular model?
